title: How to Add Currency Symbols to Numeric Fields in Business Central.
summary: BC28 introduces configurable currency symbols on numeric fields to help finance users quickly identify whether transaction amounts are in local or foreign currency. Administrators can choose symbol position and display type globally or per currency without requiring custom development.
key_points: Currency symbols can be displayed before or after numeric amounts on transactional pages
Two display options exist: LCY/FCY symbols or LCY/FCY currency codes
Configuration is available both globally in General Setup and individually on each Currency page
The feature works in both SaaS and on-premises deployments without custom development
features: Currency symbol display on numeric fields

quotes.text: BC28 introduces currency symbols for numeric fields, helping users quickly identify transaction currency directly within pages and transactional screens.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core benefit of the feature for finance users working with multiple currencies

quotes.text: It improves transaction clarity while reducing user confusion without requiring custom development.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights that this is a native feature requiring no customization, making it accessible to all organizations
